108  /**
109   * Returns a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} that the supplied {@link
110   * Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s contains.
111   *
112   * <p>The returned {@link BeanTypeList} may be {@linkplain BeanTypeList#isEmpty() empty}.</p>
113   *
114   * @param types a {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s; must not be {@code null}
115   *
116   * @return a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} drawn from the supplied
117   * {@link Collection}; never {@code null}
118   *
119   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code types} is {@code null}
120   *
121   * @microbean.nullability This method never returns {@code null}.
122   *
123   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and returns determinate values.
124   *
125   * @microbean.threadsafety This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
126   *
127   * @see #supertypes(TypeMirror, java.util.function.Predicate)
128   */
129  public final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
130    return switch (types) {
131    case null -> throw new NullPointerException("types");
132    case BeanTypeList btl -> btl;
133    case Collection<?> c when c.isEmpty() -> BeanTypeList.of();
134    case SupertypeList stl -> this.beanTypes(stl);
135    default -> {
136      int size = types.size();
137      final ArrayList<TypeMirror> newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
138      for (final TypeMirror t : types) {
139        if (legalBeanType(t)) {
140          newTypes.add(t);
141        }
142      }
143      if (newTypes.isEmpty()) {
144        yield BeanTypeList.of();
145      }
146      size = newTypes.size();
147      if (size > 1) {
148        newTypes.sort(Comparator.comparing(TypeMirror::getKind,
149                                           PrimitiveAndReferenceTypeKindComparator.INSTANCE)
150                      .thenComparing(new SpecializationComparator(this.domain()))
151                      .thenComparing(this::elementKind,
152                                     ClassesThenInterfacesElementKindComparator.INSTANCE)
153                      .thenComparing(Types::erasedName));
154      }
155      int interfaceIndex = -1;
156      for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
157        final ElementKind k = this.elementKind(newTypes.get(i));
158        if (k != null && k.isInterface()) {
159          interfaceIndex = i;
160          break;
161        }
162      }
163      yield BeanTypeList.of(this, newTypes, interfaceIndex, proxiable(newTypes.get(0), size));
164    }
165    };
166  }
167
168  private final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final SupertypeList stl) {
169    if (stl.isEmpty()) {
170      return BeanTypeList.of();
171    }
172    int size = stl.size();
173    int i = 0;
174    for (; i < size; i++) {
175      if (!legalBeanType(stl.get(i))) {
176        break;
177      }
178    }
179    if (i == size) {
180      // All types were legal.
181      return BeanTypeList.of(this, stl, proxiable(stl.get(0), size));
182    }
183    // At least one type was illegal. Start copying.
184    final ArrayList<TypeMirror> newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
185    for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
186      newTypes.add(stl.get(j)); // the type is known to be legal
187    }
188    ++i; // skip past the illegal type that was encountered
189    for (; i < size; i++) {
190      final TypeMirror t = stl.get(i);
191      if (legalBeanType(t)) {
192        newTypes.add(t);
193      }
194    }
195    newTypes.trimToSize();
196    size = newTypes.size();
197    return
198      size <= 0 ?
199      BeanTypeList.of() :
200      BeanTypeList.of(this,
201                      newTypes,
202                      stl.interfaceIndex() >= size ? -1 : stl.interfaceIndex(),
203                      proxiable(newTypes.get(0), size));
204  }
205
206  /**
207   * Returns a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} that the supplied {@link
208   * TypeMirror} bears.
209   *
210   * <p>The returned {@link BeanTypeList} may be {@linkplain BeanTypeList#isEmpty() empty}.</p>
211   *
212   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
213   *
214   * @return a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} that the supplied {@link
215   * TypeMirror} bears; never {@code null}
216   *
217   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
218   *
219   * @microbean.nullability This method never returns {@code null}.
220   *
221   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and returns determinate values.
222   *
223   * @microbean.threadsafety This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
224   *
225   * @see #supertypes(TypeMirror, java.util.function.Predicate)
226   */
227  public final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final TypeMirror t) {
228    final Domain d = this.domain();
229    switch (t.getKind()) {
230    case ARRAY:
231      return legalBeanType(t) ? BeanTypeList.of(this, List.of(t, d.javaLangObject().asType())) : BeanTypeList.of();
232    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT:
233      return BeanTypeList.of(this, List.of(t, d.javaLangObject().asType()));
234    case DECLARED, TYPEVAR:
235      final SupertypeList legalBeanSupertypes = this.supertypes(t, BeanTypes::legalBeanType);
236      return BeanTypeList.of(this,
237                             legalBeanSupertypes,
238                             proxiable(legalBeanSupertypes.get(0), legalBeanSupertypes.size()));
239    default:
240      return BeanTypeList.of();
241    }
242  }
243
244  /**
245   * Clears caches that may be used internally by this {@link BeanTypes}.
246   *
247   * @microbean.idempotency This method may clear internal state but otherwise has no side effects.
248   *
249   * @microbean.threadsafety This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
250   */
251  public final void clearCaches() {
252    this.beanTypesCache.clear();
253  }
254
255  private final ElementKind elementKind(final TypeMirror t) {
256    final Element e = this.domain().element(t);
257    return e == null ? null : e.getKind();
258  }

285  /**
286   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a <dfn>legal bean type</dfn> as defined by
287   * the <a href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types">CDI
288   * specification</a>.
289   *
290   * <p>Legal bean types are, exactly:</p>
291   *
292   * <ol>
293   *
294   * <li>{@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#ARRAY Array} types whose {@linkplain ArrayType#getComponentType()
295   * component type}s are legal bean types</li>
296   *
297   * <li>{@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#isPrimitive() Primitive} types</li>
298   *
299   * <li>{@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#DECLARED Declared} types that <dfn>contain</dfn> no {@linkplain
300   * javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#WILDCARD wildcard type}s for every interpretation and level of containment</li>
301   *
302   * </ol>
303   *
304   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
305   *
306   * @return {@code true} if and only if {@code t} is a legal bean type; {@code false} otherwise
307   *
308   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
309   *
310   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types CDI Specification, version
311   * 4.1, section 2.2.1
312   *
313   * @see <a
314   * href="https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502?focusedId=13036118&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-13036118">CDI-502</a>
315   *
316   * @see <a href="https://github.com/jakartaee/cdi/issues/823">CDI issue 823</a>
317   *
318   * @see <a href="https://issues.redhat.com/browse/WELD-1492">WELD-1492</a>
319   *
320   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
321   *
322   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
323   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
324   */
325  public static final boolean legalBeanType(final TypeMirror t) {
326    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#assignable_parameters
327    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types
328    return switch (t.getKind()) {
329
330    // "A bean type may be an array type."
331    //
332    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] An array type whose component type is not a legal bean
333    // type"
334    case ARRAY -> {
335      if (!legalBeanType(((ArrayType)t).getComponentType())) { // note recursion
336        if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
337          LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a component type that is an illegal bean type (" + ((ArrayType)t).getComponentType() + ")");
338        }
339        yield false;
340      }
341      yield true;
342    }
343
344    // "A bean type may be a primitive type. Primitive types are considered to be identical to their corresponding
345    // wrapper types in java.lang."
346    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT -> true;
347
348    // "A bean type may be a parameterized type with actual [non-wildcard, non-type-variable, see below] type parameters
349    // [arguments] and type variables." (A bean type may be a parameterized type whose type arguments are either array
350    // types, declared types, or type variables.)
351    //
352    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] A parameterized type that contains [anywhere, see
353    // below] a wildcard type parameter [argument] is not a legal bean type."
354    //
355    // Some ink has been spilled on what it means for a "parameterized" (generic) type to "contain" a "wildcard type
356    // parameter [argument]" (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502). Because it turns out that an "actual type" is a
357    // non-wildcard, non-type-variable type, it follows that *no* wildcard type argument appearing *anywhere* in a bean
358    // type's declaration is permitted. Note that this definition of "actual type" does not appear in the CDI
359    // specification, but only in a (closed) JIRA issue raised against the specification
360    // (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502?focusedId=13036118&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-13036118):
361    // "An actual type is a type that is not a wildcard nor [sic] an unresolved [sic] type variable."
362    //
363    // This still seems way overstrict to me but there you have it.
364    case DECLARED -> {
365      for (final TypeMirror ta : ((DeclaredType)t).getTypeArguments()) {
366        if (ta.getKind() != TYPEVAR && !legalBeanType(ta)) { // note recursion
367          if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
368            LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a type argument that is an illegal bean type (" + ta + ")");
369          }
370          yield false;
371        }
372      }
373      yield true;
374    }
375
376    // "A type variable is not a legal bean type." (Nothing else is either.)
377    default -> {
378      if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
379        LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " is an illegal bean type");
380      }
381      yield false;
382    }
383    };
384  }

386  /**
387   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror)
388   * legal}, {@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#DECLARED declared}, <dfn>proxiable bean type</dfn> as defined by
389   * the <a href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable">CDI specification</a>.
390   *
391   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
392   *
393   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a <dfn>proxiable bean type</dfn>
394   *
395   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
396   *
397   * @see #proxiableElement(Element)
398   *
399   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.1,
400   * section 3.10
401   *
402   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
403   *
404   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
405   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
406   */
407  public static final boolean proxiableBeanType(final TypeMirror t) {
408    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable
409    return
410      t.getKind() == DECLARED &&
411      legalBeanType(t) &&
412      proxiableElement(((DeclaredType)t).asElement());
413  }
414
415  /**
416   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Element} is an {@linkplain ElementKind#INTERFACE
417   * interface}, or a <dfn>proxiable</dfn> {@linkplain ElementKind#CLASS class}, as defined by the <a
418   * href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable">CDI specification</a>.
419   *
420   * @param e an {@link Element}; must not be {@code null}
421   *
422   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Element} is <dfn>proxiable</fn>
423   *
424   * @excepiton NullPointerException if {@code e} is {@code null}
425   *
426   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.1,
427   * section 3.10
428   *
429   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
430   *
431   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
432   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
433   */
434  static final boolean proxiableElement(final Element e) {
435    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable
436    switch (e.getKind()) {
437    case CLASS:
438      if (e.getModifiers().contains(FINAL) ||
439          e.getModifiers().contains(SEALED) ||
440          ((QualifiedNameable)e).getQualifiedName().contentEquals("java.lang.Object")) { // cheap optimization for a common case
441        return false;
442      }
443      boolean hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor = false;
444      for (final Element ee : e.getEnclosedElements()) {
445        switch (ee.getKind()) {
446        case CONSTRUCTOR:
447          if (!hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor &&
448              !ee.getModifiers().contains(PRIVATE) &&
449              ((ExecutableElement)ee).getParameters().isEmpty()) {
450            hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor = true;
451          }
452          break;
453        case METHOD:
454          final Collection<?> modifiers = ((ExecutableElement)ee).getModifiers();
455          if (modifiers.contains(FINAL) &&
456              !modifiers.contains(STATIC) &&
457              !modifiers.contains(PRIVATE)) {
458            return false;
459          }
460          break;
461        }
462      }
463      return hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor;
464    case INTERFACE:
465      return true;
466    default:
467      return false;
468    }
469  }
470
471  private static final boolean proxiable(final TypeMirror firstLegalBeanType, final int size) {
472    return
473      // Non-declared legal bean types cannot be proxied.
474      firstLegalBeanType.getKind() == TypeKind.DECLARED &&
475      ((DeclaredType)firstLegalBeanType).asElement() instanceof TypeElement e &&
476      (proxiableElement(e) ||
477       // Still potentially proxiable if the reason the firstLegalBeanType's element failed the
478       // #proxiableElement(Element) test was because the first non-interface bean type was java.lang.Object but we know
479       // that there are interfaces in this list.
480       e.getQualifiedName().contentEquals("java.lang.Object") && size > 1);
481  }
